No front door

Listeners stay listeners

A parent can hear every podcast episode and read the Playbook cover to cover without ever joining your email list. The attention is yours; the relationship belongs to the platform.

No qualifier

Calls start from zero

Someone can go from one reel to a coaching enquiry with no idea how the Internal Skills® Model works. A class lets them see it first, so the ones who apply already believe in it.

Content treadmill

980 posts and counting

Growth still leans on the next reel, the next episode and the next school booking. When you step away to write or present, new enquiries step away too.

The parents who love your content but aren't ready for coaching today have no clear next step with you, so most of them take none.

My recommendation

A free masterclass that sells a Playbook kit and fills your coaching

You already have the audience, the books and a named model. What's missing is one free 60-minute class that teaches the Internal Skills® idea, offers a low-ticket Playbook kit on the thank-you page, and invites the right parents to apply for coaching. Meta ads then put that class in front of new parents every day.

Fixes the missing front door

One free class becomes the link in your bio, the call to action on every podcast episode and the destination for your ads. Every sign-up is an email you own.

Fixes the missing qualifier

The replay page invites parents who want hands-on support to apply. You only talk to people who watched, stayed and told you what's happening at home.

Turns the books into a funnel

The Playbook kit packages your book method with tools parents can use the same night, sold at the moment they're most motivated. It helps pay for the ads.

The 95%*

Not ready for coaching yet

They join the free class, pick up the Playbook kit on the thank-you page, and keep learning from your emails and podcast. They pay you while they build trust.

The qualified 5%

Ready for hands-on support

They watch to the end and apply on the replay page. The application filters for fit before your calendar, and three pre-call emails warm them up for coaching.

*The 95% / 5% split is an industry estimate, not your data.

Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"The reminder trap"

Hook
"If you've said 'put your shoes on' five times this morning, this is for you." (to camera, suit jacket, the same blue backdrop as your profile)
Body
"Reminders work in the moment. But every reminder is a skill we're doing for them. Executive function grows when we coach the skill instead: a plan they can see, a start they own, a check-in that fades over time. That's the Internal Skills® Model." (simple on-screen captions)
CTA
"I teach it step by step in a free 60-minute class for parents called The Independence Blueprint. Tap Sign up to save your seat."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"Can't or won't?"

Hook
"Before you call it a motivation problem, ask this one question." (Michael holds up one finger)
Body
"Is this a can't or a won't? A lot of what looks like 'won't' is a skill that hasn't been built yet: starting, planning, keeping track of time. You can't consequence a skill into existence. You can coach it." (caption: can't or won't?)
CTA
"I go through the full approach in my free masterclass. Link below. Educational content, not medical advice."
Script 3 · Reel · 45 seconds

"Where to start with GrowNOW"

Hook
"Parents ask me whether to start with the podcast, the Playbook or coaching. Here's my honest answer." (walking, natural light)
Body
"If you're new here, don't pick yet. Come to my free class first. You'll learn how the Internal Skills® Model works, try it on one routine that week, and know which next step fits your family."
CTA
"It's called The Independence Blueprint, it's free, and there's a replay if you can't make it live. Tap Sign up."
